changelog:
Initial release of aso-audit: an app listing audit tool for the App Store and Google Play.

- Analyzes live listing data for metadata, visuals, ratings, and reviews.
- Scores each dimension (title, description, visuals, reviews, metadata) using clear criteria and brand maturity tier adjustments.
- Produces a prioritized action plan for ASO improvements.
- Supports both URL-based and app-name queries, with fallback for incomplete data.
- Guidance adapts based on the app’s size and market presence (Dominant, Established, Challenger).
- Checks for optional product marketing context to tailor questions and recommendations.
